aboutPage.pageSubtitle: The mind and technology shaping the industrial future.
aboutPage.cultureTitle: Mind and Technology Shaping the Industrial Future
aboutPage.cultureDesc1: Siskon is an independent engineering firm operating in industrial software, automation, and data analytics, developing its own technology with innovative solutions. From process automation to industrial internet of things, high-level traceability solutions to AI-based data systems, we make production processes more efficient, traceable, and smart. Along with our headquarters in Turkey, we operate on an international scale with our offices in Romania and Estonia.
aboutPage.cultureDesc2: SINCE 1997, we have been leading the digital transformation in the automotive, home appliances, food, textile, tobacco, and machinery sectors.
aboutPage.highlight1Text: With our own algorithms, in-house developed hardware and globally executed projects, we place software at the center of industrial intelligence. Today, Siskon-signed solutions operate in dozens of countries, across many sectors, in hundreds of systems worldwide.
aboutPage.highlight2Title: From Founders' Vision to Young Minds
aboutPage.highlight2Text: Siskon is more than a classic engineering company. We combine the seriousness of experience with the agility and openness to change of younger generations. We hear every idea, evaluate every data point, and share every success.
aboutPage.highlight3Text: Developing technology alone is not easy. That's why Siskon is a collective engineering team rather than just an institution. Experts from different disciplines, from software architects to data scientists, hardware specialists to young engineers, work with the same vision.
aboutPage.highlight4Title: Beyond Solution Partners, We Are Value Partners
aboutPage.highlight4Text: We take ownership of our business partners' goals as our own; we go beyond being a solution partner and establish value partnerships. For sustainable success, we stand by your side in every project with shared vision, trust and engineering excellence.
aboutPage.visionText: To become a globally recognized world brand with high export power, producing innovative solutions in the industrial software and automation sector; to be the most trusted solution partner in our customers' digital transformation processes with our sectoral expertise.
aboutPage.missionText: To increase the global competitiveness of enterprises with innovative, reliable and sustainable solutions in all processes from production to management in the industry's digital transformation journey.

sectorsPage.overviewIntro: Instead of forcing separate modules for each sector, we build sector-specific layers on a common OnSuite core. The cards below are sector summaries; in the next section you will find the common backbone of these eight sectors and then the details of each sector.
sectorsPage.painTitle: Sectors Are Different, Problem Is the Same
sectorsPage.painHeadline: Every Production Line Has the Same Six Problems.
sectorsPage.painLead: Although a tobacco machine, home appliance line, CNC park or food filling line may appear completely different on the surface, they all struggle with the same six fundamental problems. That's why we solve 8 sectors not with 8 separate software, but with a common OnSuite backbone and sector-specific layers.
sectorsPage.backboneHeadline: One Backbone · 11 Modules · More Data, More Insight, More Improvement
sectorsPage.backboneLead: OnSuite - Sector-Independent Core, Sector-Specific Layers. The modules below are fed from the same core in every sector project. Our sector packages (Hybrid, Organic, A+++, Capsule Track and Trace) are sector-configured combinations of these modules; not software from scratch, but the sector layer of the backbone.
sectorsPage.ctaFinal: Let's plan the next step together.
sectorsPage.ctaSuffix: Share your priorities, let's prepare a focused transformation plan.

onSuitePage.heroSubtitle: Siskon's next-generation smart manufacturing platform brings 11 modules together under one roof.
onSuitePage.introDesc: OnSuite is an industrial software family consisting of 11 modules. Each module can be deployed independently or as an integrated suite, on-premise or in the cloud. It is designed with React + C# API + MS SQL architecture, stored procedure-focused approach and fully automated SQL testing with tSQLt. It offers open protocol support with OPC UA, PackML, ISA-88, MTConnect, REST and MQTT.
onSuitePage.modulesDesc: Deploy OnSuite modules individually or configure them as a single connected ecosystem from production to management.
